review_description: Installation was 2Kw with a 3.6Kw Aurora Power one Inverter.Whole process was generally very smooth and went well.Had some installation issues however they were immediately acknowledged and rectified.Final result and current system operation after a month of being installed is very satisfactory.
I received one quote which was from  Renewable EnergyThe Rep was very helpful and the price competitive, however they offered the Poly Panels, where as I preferred the Mono Panels.
